build_multimodal_transformer: build a MultimodalTransformer with modal dims, lengths, embed dim, and depth for multi-modal feature extraction
build_multimodal_mae_decoder: build a MultimodalMAEDecoder with modal channels and shared mask tokens for masked autoencoding
run_forward_features: run forward_features on a list of modality tensors with optional masks to get normalized patch tokens
test_apply_mask: test the apply_mask method with tube or block mask types on multi-modal tensor inputs
review_transcode: review the transcode method to understand shared versus per-modality attention block processing
